blocked.name: Lorehold, the Historian
blocked.why: Granting miracle {2} to instants and sorceries in hand needs miracle itself (first-card-drawn tracking and a cast-on-draw offer), which isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
blocked.why: Exiling a graveyard card, copying it and casting the copy for free during resolution isn't expressible, and the copy may be an artifact or enchantment (a permanent-spell copy).

blocked.name: Krark, the Thumbless
blocked.why: copy-spell only copies a targeted spell, not the triggering one, and copies always keep the original's targets instead of offering new ones.

blocked.name: Infinite Guideline Station
blocked.why: Station and Spacecraft (charge counters from tapping another creature, becomes a creature at 12+) aren't modeled (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Niko, Light of Hope
blocked.why: 'Shards you control become copies of it until the next end step' needs existing permanents to become copies of an object for a duration.

blocked.name: Prismari, the Inspiration
blocked.why: Storm copies are made with the original's targets (copyStackSpell), so 'you may choose new targets for the copies' is lost.

blocked.name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice
blocked.why: Populate copies the largest creature token by power rather than letting the player choose which token to copy (AUTHORING §15 Partial).

blocked.name: Volo, Guide to Monsters
blocked.why: Copying a creature spell (it becomes a token) isn't modeled (copyStackSpell refuses permanent spells), nor is the 'doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control or in your graveyard' cast-trigger clause.

blocked.name: Kastral, the Windcrested
blocked.why: Mode one picks a Bird card from hand OR graveyard in one choice; choose-from-zone can't span two zones.

blocked.name: Saheeli, Radiant Creator
blocked.why: The token copy is 'a 5/5 artifact creature in addition to its other types'; create-token-copy can set base P/T but can't add card types as a copy exception.

blocked.name: Raffine, Scheming Seer
blocked.why: Connive X (draw, discard, counters per nonland discarded) has no effect in the engine.

blocked.name: Yidris, Maelstrom Wielder
blocked.why: Nothing grants cascade to the spells you cast from hand for the rest of the turn, and cascade's free cast can't be declined and auto-picks targets.

blocked.name: Tannuk, Steadfast Second
blocked.why: Granting warp {2}{R} to cards in hand needs warp, which isn't modeled (AUTHORING §15, Starfield Vocalist).

blocked.name: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria
blocked.why: Connive isn't modeled, and 'whenever you discard one or more land cards' needs a batched, filtered discard trigger.

blocked.name: Aloy, Savior of Meridian
blocked.why: Discover isn't modeled, and X is the greatest power among the attack batch, which AUTHORING §15 says can't be expressed faithfully.

blocked.name: Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector
blocked.why: Venom's 'you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw X ... where X is the sacrificed creature's mana value' needs a chosen optional sacrifice whose follow-up reads what was sacrificed.

blocked.name: Shiko and Narset, Unified
blocked.why: Flurry copies the triggering spell only 'if it targets a permanent or player' with new targets (and it may be a permanent spell); none of that is expressible.

blocked.name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
blocked.why: Keeping unspent green mana across steps and +1/+1 per unspent green mana both need hooks on the mana pool that don't exist.

blocked.name: Shilgengar, Sire of Famine
blocked.why: There's no Blood token (its 'Discard a card' activation cost isn't expressible), and 'Sacrifice six Blood tokens' as a cost isn't either.

blocked.name: Iron Man, Titan of Innovation
blocked.why: 'You may sacrifice a noncreature artifact. If you do, search for an artifact with mana value 1 plus the sacrificed one's' needs a chosen optional sacrifice feeding its follow-up.

blocked.name: Thranduil, the Elvenking
blocked.why: Having all activated abilities of Elf cards in your graveyard (the Necrotic Ooze shape) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Tayam, Luminous Enigma
blocked.why: 'Remove three counters from among creatures you control' as a cost isn't expressible; removeCounter only comes off the source.

blocked.name: Brenard, Ginger Sculptor
blocked.why: Exiling the dead creature from the graveyard and making a token copy that is also a 1/1 Food Golem artifact with a granted ability needs copy exceptions and copying a card that has left the battlefield.

blocked.name: Phenax, God of Deception
blocked.why: 'As long as your devotion to blue and black is less than seven, Phenax isn't a creature' needs a devotion condition and a conditional removal of its own card type.

blocked.name: Indominus Rex, Alpha
blocked.why: 'As it enters, discard any number of creature cards', with counters keyed to their keywords, needs an any-number discard as an as-enters replacement.

blocked.name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
blocked.why: Casting artifacts from your graveyard for an extra 3 life, entering with a finality counter because they were cast that way, isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Athreos, God of Passage
blocked.why: 'Isn't a creature' while devotion to white and black is below seven needs a devotion condition and a conditional self type removal.

blocked.name: Coram, the Undertaker
blocked.why: +X/+0 from the greatest power in all graveyards is an aggregate in the layer fold (§15), and playing lands and casting spells from any graveyard (including opponents' cards) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Marvo, Deep Operative
blocked.why: Clash isn't modeled, nor is casting a spell from hand for free during resolution.

blocked.name: The Infamous Cruelclaw
blocked.why: Casting the exiled card by discarding a card instead of paying its mana cost, during resolution, isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain
blocked.why: Doubling every kind of counter on one attacker, then token copies of each attached permanent attached to it, isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss
blocked.why: 'Each creature you control with a mana ability' needs a has-a-mana-ability filter clause, which CardFilter doesn't have.

blocked.name: Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes
blocked.why: A new Boo against an old one is settled by the legend rule's oldest-survives default, not the player's choice. The −2's 'Sacrifice a creature. When you do …' can't bind the sacrificed creature to its reflexive trigger.

blocked.name: Alexios, Deimos of Kosmos
blocked.why: 'Can't be sacrificed', and giving control of it to the player whose upkeep it is, aren't expressible.

blocked.name: Omnath, Locus of Rage
blocked.why: As a commander, choosing the command zone is a pre-move replacement in the engine, so 'Whenever Omnath dies' never fires when it's moved there. Under current rule 903.9a it dies first.

blocked.name: Kalamax, the Stormsire
blocked.why: Copying the triggering instant (not a targeted one) with new targets isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Slimefoot and Squee
blocked.why: 'Return this card and up to one other target creature card' puts the two onto the battlefield one after another rather than simultaneously (AUTHORING §15 Partial names this exact wording).

blocked.name: Obeka, Brute Chronologist
blocked.why: Ending the turn (rule 723.1) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Brimaz, Blight of Oreskos
blocked.why: Incubate and the double-faced Incubator token aren't modeled.

blocked.name: Xenagos, God of Revels
blocked.why: 'Isn't a creature' while devotion to red and green is below seven needs a devotion condition and a conditional self type removal.

blocked.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
blocked.why: 'You may sacrifice an artifact, creature, … If you do, each opponent may sacrifice a permanent that shares a card type with it' needs an optional chosen sacrifice whose follow-up reads the sacrificed permanent.

blocked.name: Haldan, Avid Arcanist
blocked.why: Playing cards you exiled that have fetch counters, spending mana as though it were any colour, isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Pako, Arcane Retriever
blocked.why: Exiling the top card of each player's library with a fetch counter on each isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Strefan, Maurer Progenitor
blocked.why: There's no Blood token, no 'you may sacrifice two Blood tokens. If you do …' and no putting a card from hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

blocked.name: Ghave, Guru of Spores
blocked.why: 'Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control' as a cost needs the counter taken from a chosen permanent, not only the source.

blocked.name: Vnwxt, Verbose Host
blocked.why: Start your engines!/speed and max speed aren't modeled.

blocked.name: Saskia the Unyielding
blocked.why: 'As Saskia enters, choose a player' has no player-choice form (chooseOnEnter is a fixed string list) and would only fire when it's cast.

blocked.name: Talion, the Kindly Lord
blocked.why: 'Choose a number between 1 and 10' as it enters, then matching a spell's mana value, power or toughness to it, has no filter comparison against a chosen value, and the choice would only fire when it's cast.

blocked.name: Maelstrom Wanderer
blocked.why: Cascade's free cast can't be declined and auto-picks its targets (castCardWithoutPaying commits a cascade cast with the first legal target).

blocked.name: Sen Triplets
blocked.why: Playing cards from an opponent's hand and making them play with their hand revealed aren't modeled.

blocked.name: Xavier Sal, Infested Captain
blocked.why: 'Remove a counter from another permanent you control' as a cost isn't expressible, and populate doesn't let the player choose the token.

blocked.name: Grist, the Hunger Tide
blocked.why: Being a 1/1 Insect creature off the battlefield, the +1's repeat-while-an-Insect-is-milled loop and the −2's 'you may sacrifice a creature. When you do' aren't expressible.

blocked.name: Kellan, the Kid
blocked.why: Casting a permanent spell from hand for free during resolution isn't expressible (and the 'if you don't' land fallback depends on it).

blocked.name: Mishra, Eminent One
blocked.why: The token copy's name is Mishra's Warform and it's a 4/4 Construct artifact creature in addition to its other types. create-token-copy can't rename a copy or add types.

blocked.name: Myrkul, Lord of Bones
blocked.why: A token copy of the exiled card that is an enchantment and loses all other card types needs copy exceptions and copying a card off the battlefield.

blocked.name: Ellivere of the Wild Court
blocked.why: Role tokens (the Virtuous Role, its one-Role-per-player SBA) and creating an Aura token attached to a target aren't modeled.

blocked.name: Koma, Cosmos Serpent
blocked.why: A modal activated ability with a targeted mode ('tap target permanent') chosen as it's activated isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Ozai, the Phoenix King
blocked.why: Unspent mana becoming red instead of being lost, and flying/indestructible with six or more unspent mana, need mana-pool hooks.

blocked.name: Gluntch, the Bestower
blocked.why: Choosing three players at resolution, and the first choosing a creature they control for the counters, aren't expressible.

blocked.name: The Gitrog, Ravenous Ride
blocked.why: Saddle isn't modeled, nor is 'you may sacrifice a creature that saddled it. If you do, draw X … where X is its power'.

blocked.name: Breena, the Demagogue
blocked.why: 'You put two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control' is an untargeted choice of permanent at resolution, which isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer
blocked.why: Face-down creature spells and permanents (morph/manifest/disguise) aren't modeled.

blocked.name: Sméagol, Helpful Guide
blocked.why: The Ring tempts you is not modeled (AUTHORING §15).

newFeatures.new:temporary-spell-ability-grant: A one-shot effect that gives the spells its controller casts for the rest of the turn a keyword or triggered ability, optionally only those cast from a given zone (Yidris: 'as you cast spells from your hand this turn, they gain cascade'). The static grantsToSpells form exists, but nothing grants it for a duration.
newFeatures.new:compare-to-chosen-value: A filter or trigger clause that compares a number (a spell's mana value, power or toughness) against a value chosen as the permanent entered (Talion, the Kindly Lord's chosen number).
